candidateCorrection: Owned simulator environment only; no source, product, oracle, key injection, focus or timeout changes

environment.delta: Simulator frontend attached to only owned device; documented Connect Hardware Keyboard selected before Settings and kept through Tab
environment.device: one new uniquely named root-owned simulator
environment.frontendCustody: Capture original host baseline separately; selected frontend identity goes in inner root baselineFrontends; root closes only newly owned frontend/window after inner cleanup and reconciles original baseline.

hypothesis: Keeping a simulated hardware keyboard connected prevents scene focus-system teardown during the original XCTest Tab

outcomeRules.ineligible: Connection cannot be verified/isolated or preparation needs unreviewed runtime changes; stop before XCTest and preserve remaining attempt.
outcomeRules.otherFailure: Focus system remains available but Tab fails: preserve the new failure and distinguish ordering/eligibility from availability; no oracle waiver.
outcomeRules.refutesSufficiency: Verified connected configuration still loses focus-system availability or fails strict Tab; keep failure, no automatic retry.
outcomeRules.supportsHypothesis: Settings and original strict Tab pass with stable available focus system and a changed fixed target, official import and cleanup pass. This supports the tested environment correction only.

requiredReview: Any new runtime/compiled/launcher packet requires fresh existing source+binding review before dispatch; this proposal waives nothing.
sequence: Parent selects this exact environment experiment and retains original failed baseline.
